simple.meaning: a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אַצִּיל (H679) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אַצִּיל (ʼatstsîyl) means a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8) First listed occurrence: Ezek 13 18.

definitions.short: a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8)
definitions.full: H679. atstsil [ אַצִּיל noun [feminine] joining, joint (compare elbow ) — plural construct [ י ] יד אַצִּילֵי Ezek 13:18 (on יד compare Sm Co); — joint of hand, i.e. elbow 13:18 ; יָדֶיךָ אַצִּילוֺת Jer 38:12 arm-joints. — אִַצּילָה׃ Ezek 41:8 obscure; perhaps ׳א is here a technical architectural term to the joining (compare Sm Ke).
definitions.rootNote: from 680 (in its primary sense of uniting);
